summary: MotionEye provides a web-based user interface for managing the Motion video surveillance daemon. It allows you to monitor camera feeds and configure motion detection settings through a browser. The application is built using Python and is commonly packaged as a container.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want a dedicated browser interface for the Motion surveillance engine without configuring text files manually.
watchOut: It relies entirely on the underlying Motion software for core video processing and detection, which can be resource-intensive depending on your camera resolution and frame rate.
deployNotes: You will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for your recorded video footage and use a reverse proxy if you require TLS termination for remote access.
